DB_TYPE.description: Database engine: postgres for production, sqlite for local dev

PG_HOSTNAME.description: PostgreSQL server hostname (localhost or Railway DB host)

PG_DATABASE.description: Name of PostgreSQL database for Keycloak

PG_USERNAME.description: Username for connecting to PostgreSQL database

PG_PASSWORD.description: Password for the Keycloak PostgreSQL user

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Initial admin username for Keycloak master realm (default: admin)

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial admin password for Keycloak master realm (first startup)

KC_PROXY.description: Proxy mode: 'edge' for Railway TLS termination

KEYCLOAK_HOSTNAME.description: Public URL for accessing Keycloak (must match Railway domain)

PORT.description: Port the service listens on inside the container
